note: Do not instantiate directly; use itasca.ball.cfd module functions.

method_groups.force: force, force_x, force_y, force_z, set_force, set_force_x, set_force_y, set_force_z
method_groups.pos: pos, pos_x, pos_y, pos_z, set_pos, set_pos_x, set_pos_y, set_pos_z

methods.name: ball
methods.description: Get the ball corresponding to this CFD ball.

methods.name: elements
methods.signature: cfdball.elements() -> tuple of CFD element objects
methods.description: Get a tuple of CFD elements associated with a CFD ball.

methods.name: extra
methods.description: Get the CFD ball extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: force
methods.description: Get the CFD ball fluid force (vector).

methods.name: force_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the CFD ball fluid force.

methods.name: force_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the CFD ball fluid force.

methods.name: force_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the CFD ball fluid force.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Get the CFD ball group name in a given slot.

methods.name: group_remove
methods.signature: cfdball.group_remove(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> int
methods.description: Remove from the given group from the CFD ball. One argument of type string, giving the group name, is required. The return value is an integer which is the first slot in which the group name was found or -1 if not found.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Get a tuple of group names assigned to this CFD ball.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Get the CFD ball id.

methods.name: in_group
methods.signature: cfdball.in_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Test if the CFD ball is part of a given group. All group slots are searched.

methods.name: overlaps
methods.description: Get a tuple of the volumes of overlap between this ball and the CFD elements. The volumes returned correspond to the elements returned by the elements method.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Get the CFD ball location (vector).

methods.name: pos_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the CFD ball location.

methods.name: pos_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the CFD ball location.

methods.name: pos_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the CFD ball location.

methods.name: set_extra
methods.description: Set the CFD ball extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: set_force
methods.description: Set the CFD ball fluid force (vector).

methods.name: set_force_x
methods.description: Set the x-component of the CFD ball fluid force.

methods.name: set_force_y
methods.description: Set the y-component of the CFD ball fluid force.

methods.name: set_force_z
methods.description: Set the z-component of the CFD ball fluid force.

methods.name: set_group
methods.signature: cfdball.set_group([group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]]) -> None
methods.description: Set the CFD ball group name in a given slot.

methods.name: set_pos
methods.description: Set the CFD ball location (vector).

methods.name: set_pos_x
methods.description: Set the x-component of the CFD ball location.

methods.name: set_pos_y
methods.description: Set the y-component of the CFD ball location.

methods.name: set_pos_z
methods.description: Set the z-component of the CFD ball location.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Returns True if this CFD ball is live.
